snippet.title: Junklands | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Take on the role of a brave paper fledgling named Rahr as you navigate a polluted world in this 3D action-platformer. Frosty Games Fest premieres a brand-new trailer for Junklands featuring updated visuals and never-before-seen locales such as Brinebone – a dried out ocean desert with a raging sandstorm. You’ll also catch a first glimpse at the Drill Work miniboss along with other snippets of new gameplay in this perilous quest across smog-filled lands.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2724220/Junklands/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
